SUBJECT: Consideration of Bid #E-6-20 for furnishing a minimum of three (3) to a maximum
often(10), lift-equipped transit vehicles, forthe City of Cheyenne, Transit Division
Bid #E-6-20 was solicited for the purchase of lift equipped transit vehicles, for the City of
Cheyenne Transit Program.The bid requested pricing for a three (3)year period, with a base bid
cost for the vehicle, with add-on costs for each individual option.This allows the Transit
department to request the award of additional vehicles at a future time.
Two(2)bidders responded to this bid, and the bid tabulation is attached.
The two (2) bids were received by Colorado/West Equipment, Inc.,(Henderson, CO), and Davey
Coach, (Sedalia, CO).Fremont Motor Company, (Sheridan, WY), submitted a“NO BID".The
lowest responsive bidder, Colorado/West Equipment, Inc.complied with all provisions of the
bidding documents.
The bids were reviewed by Renae Jording (Transit), Keith Mc Queen (Transit), and Bryan Bell
(Fleet Maintenance).Their recommendation is to accept the bid from Colorado/West Equipment,
Inc., for a bid award amount of $281,982.48, for this individual award. The requested bid award
amount is for thepurchase of three(3)lift equipped transit vehicles, with add-on options, for a
cost of $93,994.16/each.
